triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '4. Running served TTFT after an operator-negative row pipeline' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 4. Running served TTFT after an operator-negative row pipeline

problem.statement: SM120 RMSNorm-MLP PDL Pitfalls -- 4. Running served TTFT after an operator-negative row pipeline

payload.attempted: A row-chunk pipeline is bit-exact, so run the expensive served gate anyway.
payload.lesson: Do not run served TTFT while the clean component gate is negative.

established_fact.mechanism: Correctness and performance gates are separate. Launch repetition, scheduler setup, tile inefficiency, synchronization, and output copies can make a correct row pipeline slower.

payload.observed: Component medians were already slower across the tested M range. Served testing would only measure a known-negative path with more noise.
payload.root_cause: Correctness and performance gates are separate. Launch repetition, scheduler setup, tile inefficiency, synchronization, and output copies can make a correct row pipeline slower.
